topic: Other Open-Source Repositories: rhomes, Cybersmarter-business-system & firstlight-apartment
content: Apart from this live Kubernetes AI stack you are currently engaging with, Brighton also maintains three public repositories under https://github.com/Gachagokimani: (1) rhomes — a TypeScript scalable rental listings platform automating property discovery and tenant-landlord workflows; (2) Cybersmarter-business-system — a TypeScript end-to-end business management system for operational scaling, inventory control, and workflow automation; and (3) firstlight-apartment — a JavaScript residential rental showcase and unit inquiry web application.
